background: BNY is the holding company of the world's largest custodian bank, earning fees from safekeeping, settlement, asset servicing and investment management for institutions rather than from lending.
synthesis: As a holding company its ratings sit a notch below the bank's: A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, with a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 5 Nov 2024 the latest move. Consolidated capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 11.9% is just below the peer median, while leverage of 6.7% is in the top quarter. LCR of 111% sits below the peer median, on the weak side; CET1 has risen 0.7 points since 31 Dec 2021 and the rest has been flat. The newest flagged item, on 15 Jul 2026, is a strong quarter with a dividend increase, alongside an older legal item over a self-dealing suit.
